description: DB-M14 top-level AI routing configuration. MANUAL is the ONLY active runtime mode. ASSISTED and AUTO are represented as future values only - neither activates automated AI execution. Routing policy is explicitly NOT implemented (DB-M19); these defaults are inert.

futureModes.ASSISTED: DevBridge recommends model/cost/reasoning/budget/fallback; human executes. Enable only after DB-M19 dry-run gate G3.
futureModes.AUTO: DevBridge invokes providers itself. NOT ALLOWED until a governance gate (new ADR + workbook update + explicit enable flag + kill switch) passes.

routingDefaults.policyVersionNote: Routing policy is not implemented until DB-M19. Defaults are inert configuration, not routing.

notes: DB-M14. NO AUTOMATIC AI EXECUTION EXISTS YET. All providers and models in providers.json/models.json are Enabled=false / Configured=false.
